brief:
Pull FedWiki timeline pages and render formal executive-brief PDFs — one brief per timeline plus a combined dossier whose "Unified Summary" layer is built from the In-brief summaries. Use when turning the *.timeline.ide.earth subdomain wikis (or any same-shaped FedWiki answer pages) into shareable, executive-style PDF documents, or when re-rendering offline from a cached model. ReportLab only — no LaTeX, GTK or browser engine. Kept by the Librarian 🗃️; the Unified Summary is the Chronicler's compression.

**🗃️📄 Wiki to PDF — the federation, bound for people who read on paper** Keeper: the Librarian 🗃️ · Authored by the Chronicler 🧙📖 · Category: wikis · Layer: distribution

> One core, many bindings: the brief is the wiki folded small.

Turns the federated timeline wikis into formal PDF documents. Source of truth is the **live** `*.timeline.ide.earth` subdomains, read over public GET (no cookie needed).
